name: Chimera Pro
storyline: The mysterious Kronos Corporation is harboring dangerous secrets, and an elite agent codenamed 'Chimera' has just broken into their high-security facility. Operating completely from the shadows, you are 'Control'—the remote handler stationed at the terminal on the other end of the comms line.As Chimera navigates the heavily guarded corporate labyrinth, you are their eyes and ears. Through real-time encrypted data feeds and urgent messaging, you must analyze situations, bypass security tech via hacking protocols, and make split-second operational decisions. Every directive you issue influences Chimera's choices, steering the team through a high-tech underworld where a single wrong call could blow their cover or compromise the entire mission.
summary: Step into the role of 'Control' in Project: Chimera, a gripping sci-fi spy thriller RPG and interactive visual novel. You are the remote handler guiding elite agent Chimera through a dangerous infiltration of the mysterious Kronos Corporation. Every text message and choice you make determines their survival.Features a deep branching narrative packed with tension, immersive visual novel elements, intense system-hacking minigames, and crucial resource/stat management (health, suspicion, and assets) to uncover corporate secrets.
